terms.title: ULIQ Presale Terms
terms.description: Terms for participating in the ULIQ presale, including payment, withdrawal, allocation and vesting.
terms.pendingDescription: The seller details marked in square brackets still need to be completed. This draft is not the final purchase agreement.

seller.title: 1. Seller and scope
seller.body: These terms describe the purchase of ULIQ through the uLiquid Desk presale. Contact for purchases, withdrawals and complaints: support@uliquid.vip. Separate platform terms and privacy information apply to use of uLiquid Desk.

token.title: 2. Token and network
token.body: ULIQ is the utility token intended for use within uLiquid Desk. A purchase does not by itself grant company shares, dividends, repayment of capital or a guaranteed return. The presale uses Arbitrum One (chain ID 42161). ULIQ: 0xF2Fa252134c84Fcf260c73665BAf3f8cCBe03EEd. Payment is accepted only in native USDC on that network: 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831. Do not send funds directly to a token contract or an address supplied by an unsolicited message.

rounds.title: 3. Sale rounds and purchase limits
rounds.body: Round 1 offers up to 50,000,000 ULIQ at 0.002 USDC per ULIQ, with a cap of 100,000 USDC. The minimum purchase is 500 USDC and the cumulative maximum is 10,000 USDC per wallet. Round 2 offers up to 100,000,000 ULIQ at 0.0035 USDC per ULIQ, with a cap of 350,000 USDC. The minimum purchase is 100 USDC and the cumulative maximum is 5,000 USDC per wallet. Limits apply separately to each round. A valid withdrawal restores purchase capacity. There is no minimum fundraising target that automatically triggers a refund. The start and end of each round will be displayed on the presale page before participation.

purchase.title: 4. Purchase process and custody
purchase.body: Review the active round, accepted USDC amount, ULIQ allocation and wallet transaction before confirming a purchase. An approval alone is not a purchase. A confirmed purchase first creates a pending allocation; it does not immediately deliver transferable ULIQ. Pending USDC remains in the custody contract assigned to that round. At finalization, USDC goes to the seller's designated Safe treasury and the full ULIQ allocation is funded into the round's vesting contract. Use a wallet you control and verify the network.

withdrawal.title: 5. Withdrawal and refunds
withdrawal.body: The contractual withdrawal period is 14 days (1,209,600 seconds) from the recorded purchase time. The buyer may withdraw their own pending purchase through the deadline shown for that purchase. A successful withdrawal cancels the allocation and returns the full recorded USDC amount to the buying wallet. Use the withdrawal action in the purchase history. For access problems or other withdrawal requests, contact support@uliquid.vip promptly with the wallet address and transaction reference; never send private keys or a recovery phrase. After finalization, the contract no longer offers withdrawal of that purchase. Additional rights and remedies required by applicable law remain unaffected.

finalization.title: 6. Finalization and sale completion
finalization.body: After the withdrawal deadline, any caller may finalize a pending purchase for the original buyer. The caller receives no part of the allocation. A sale pause prevents new purchases but does not remove available withdrawal or matured-finalization paths. Ending a round does not automatically settle all purchases. Both rounds must have no pending purchases and be ready for listing before the shared listing time can be scheduled. Round 2 cannot start until Round 1 has ended. Finalization is separate from the later release of vested tokens.

vesting.title: 7. Vesting and claims
vesting.body: Both rounds use one shared listing timestamp. Round 1 makes 5% of the finalized allocation claimable at listing. The remaining 95% is released linearly over 548 days after a 90-day cliff. Round 2 makes 25% claimable at listing and releases the remaining 75% linearly over 274 days, without a cliff. No ULIQ is claimable before the shared listing time. Claims are made by the beneficiary wallet; an amount becoming available does not automatically send a transaction. There is no right to accelerate the agreed vesting schedule. Optional locking of wallet-held ULIQ is a separate action and is not performed automatically by the presale.

listing.title: 8. Listing and exceptional cases
listing.body: The project commits to listing ULIQ. The schedule will be communicated through official project channels. Listing does not guarantee a market price, trading volume, liquidity or access to every exchange. The contracts do not provide automatic full-sale cancellation or a refund triggered solely by a listing delay. Exceptional cases will be reviewed and handled manually by the seller, with applicable remedies communicated to affected buyers. A manual USDC payment does not itself cancel or change an existing onchain vesting entitlement. Mandatory buyer rights remain unaffected.

fees.title: 9. Network fees and wallet security
fees.body: Wallet transactions on Arbitrum require ETH for network fees. Review the fee shown by your wallet before signing. The contract returns the recorded USDC amount on withdrawal; it does not itself reimburse ETH network fees. Any reimbursement required by applicable law remains unaffected. Do not share private keys or recovery phrases. Transactions to an incorrect network or address may be unrecoverable. The seller cannot sign on your behalf or restore access to a wallet whose keys have been lost.

risks.title: 10. Risks and responsibility
risks.body: Token purchases involve risks including loss of value, limited liquidity, smart-contract defects, network disruption, USDC issuer restrictions or loss of its reference value, and delays to project services. You may lose the entire value committed. A presale price is not a guaranteed future market price. Consider whether the purchase is appropriate for your circumstances and read the linked risk disclosure. Nothing in these terms excludes liability or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded.

version.title: 11. Version, support and mandatory rights
version.body: The completed terms must identify their version and publication date. The version presented and accepted for a purchase governs that purchase; a later version does not by itself change an existing purchase or its immutable vesting schedule. Contact support@uliquid.vip for purchase-related support and complaints. Seller identity, address and contact details must be completed before this draft is used as final terms. Mandatory consumer protections and other rights that apply regardless of these terms remain unaffected.
